analysis: The PR changes documentation only. docs/developer/test.md gets a date bump and a new 'Watchdog launch evidence' section. It describes a bounded swift test selection for WatchdogRecoveryService.observeHealthyProvider using synthetic bundles, loopback release HTTP and injected launch/process callbacks. docs/developer/build.md, as seen in the head text, covers pinned MLX submodule revisions, build steps, App Attest release qualification and the runtime-smoke checks. It also adds a cross-reference to the watchdog test procedure (build.md ~L668-671). No executable code, auth logic, attestation verification, crypto, billing or data-exposure behavior changes. The docs say the selection does not qualify a signed release, native launchd or the full suite, so they make no overclaim. This is relevant to T-043 (watchdog rollback authority) and T-041/T-054 only as context. No threat assumptions are invalidated, and the new text needs no threat-model update. build.md has only a head_text view, with no patch or base side, so I cannot tell exactly which lines changed there. I saw nothing security-relevant in it, such as secrets or unsafe instructions. The documented commands run locally and do not weaken controls, so no deeper review is needed.
